Hi Sara,

Scouting the Single Dad arriving this September, as part of your Axes & Endzones series, caught my eye, and a single dad hero is such a loved hook in contemporary romance.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

Since the audiobook is already available, I wanted to mention a different option. If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Scouting the Single Dad is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, including visuals and music. It is entirely optional and can sit alongside the feature.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Scouting the Single Dad best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
